name: Brave Cute
source:
A heroine of justice who fights to stop the ambitions of Mistress, who manipulates people's minds, by using a variety of magic.

She is a shy and reserved girl who is not good at socializing with others. She is a virgin. Her transformation item are magical earrings called "Brave Earring".

[Translation from [url=http://amatures.ohimesama.net/sentou/]Official Site[/url]]
